classification: AI-generated ink-and-pencil-style educational artwork, not commissioned hand drawing or verified specimen photography
limitations: Common phenotype study; not all morphs or a genetic predictor. Raster edits are region masked. Specialist plates require separate review.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a professional zoological specimen drawing of ONE adult Correlophus ciliatus, crested gecko, in strict lateral side profile facing LEFT, entire animal visible including long slender prehensile tail curving to right. Landscape 1536x1024. Plain warm ivory #f4efdf background, no labels, shadows or scenery. Fine brown-black archival ink contours, painstaking tiny granular scales, delicate stipple and parallel pencil hatching, restrained dry colored pencil umber pigment. NO watercolor, paint wash, digital airbrush, blur or fantasy. Accurate broad triangular head, blunt muzzle, large slit-pupil bronze eye, eyelash crests above eye, two dorsal rows of pointed crest scales from behind eyes to pelvic region, five anatomically correct lamellate digits per foot, short stocky limbs, muscular moderate adult torso. Plain brown patternless animal with no cream stripes or markings, uniform warm medium brown body, lighter natural belly only. Body/head occupy x 12%-67%, torso x35%-65%, dorsal crest y35%-43%, belly y60%-66%, tail from x65% toward90%; feet extend below. Strong legible hand-drawn line work and pencil texture remains visible at webpage size. Museum scientific drawing, not cute cartoon.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the exact specimen drawing, pose, contours, proportions, scale linework, ivory paper background and canvas dimensions. Retain dry colored pencil and fine ink/stipple, never watercolor. Add a realistic high-expression harlequin pattern: irregular ivory cream tongues, branching islands and ragged interlocking patches climbing UP from the lower flanks toward the dorsal rows, irregular cream on limbs, and a separate cream dorsal field with jagged edges. Keep a network of brown negative space. No symmetrical zebra bands, no smooth blobs, no speckled white dust, no pinstripe. The head has subtle cream accents. Anatomically follow scale topology. No text. Keep every existing line and unmodified pixel position registered to the original for layer compositing.
